# nemau storage object presign

Get a direct URL to an object, bypassing the API.

The URL works with any HTTP client:

```
curl -o file "$(nemau storage object presign photos holiday.jpg -q)"
```

It bypasses the API for the transfer itself: no 100 MiB cap, and no extra hop
on every byte.

It is a bearer token for that object until it expires. Do not put it in a log
or in a shared environment variable.

## Usage

```
nemau storage object presign <container> <key> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --expires-in duration   how long it stays valid (platform default: 15m, cap: 1h)
      --method string         GET to download, PUT to upload (default "GET")
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
